structured.feedback: The response is weak on SEO: "eyeliner" shows up only once (in the H1), none of the subheadings use keywords, and the title's main search terms ("waterproof," "smudge-proof," "liquid eyeliner pen") are missing. It also blends features and benefits instead of clearly separating them, and phrases like "keeping your eyes free of panda eyes" and "Endless Looks" are clumsy or generic.
